subject: Technical governance and listing checklist for partner connectors
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@cloudforge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Technical governance and listing checklist for partner connectors

Hi Sarah —

Great to meet last week on the partner call. As we prepare the Cloud Marketplace listing and co-sell readiness for CloudForge's connector, the marketplace team asked us to capture a few technical governance items up front so the certification sprint has no surprises.

Attached is a short checklist that covers: runtime footprint, expected peak QPS, network egress patterns, auth options (OIDC/mTLS), and sample telemetry we need for co-sell telemetry tagging. Can you confirm who on your side will own the topology diagram and provide the initial connector binary (or artifact link) for our validation team?

High-level ask and timeline:
- Share topology + artifact by Oct 14 (this Friday)
- Security questionnaire answers and SOC2 evidence by Oct 21
- Billing/plan SKU mapping for marketplace listing by Oct 25

I'll loop Connor from marketplace ops for the entitlement mapping and Ben for technical validation. If these dates don't work, tell me and we'll adjust.

Thanks —
Rachel Kim
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
(rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com)

Attachment: redwood-marketplace-technical-checklist.pdf (1 page PDF)
From: Sarah Lee <sarah@cloudforge.io>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Oliver Stern <oliver.stern@platformops.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Oct 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Technical governance and listing checklist for partner connectors

Thanks Rachel — appreciate the clear list. We'll own the topology diagram and Oliver (platform lead) will provide the artifact link. Quick notes:

- Topology: we'll include a diagram for both single-tenant and shared SaaS deployments.
- Artifact: we'll provide an OCI image + a tarball of the connector integration tests.
- Auth: we support OIDC and can enable mTLS for the private deployment path.

Oliver and I will aim to get the topology + artifact to you by EOD Oct 14. On SOC2 evidence, our security team needs a reminder note from Redwood about the specific evidence fields you require (retention windows, audit log retention, KMS usage). Could you send the precise evidence checklist?

Sarah Lee
Head of Partnerships, CloudForge Solutions
(sarah@cloudforge.io)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2027 08:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical governance and listing checklist for partner connectors

Looping in a quick checklist for internal validation:

- Runtime smoke tests: small sample (10m) on g4/p4 equiv, check latency p50/p95 at 1k tokens per request.
- KV/prefix caching behavior: ensure cache keys are deterministic across restarts.
- Telemetry tags: need partner_id, listing_sku, region, request_path in token-level logs.
- Network diagram: highlight any external dependencies (third-party auth, external DBs) and egress CIDRs.
- Security evidence: SOC2 report PDF, Acess Control policy, KMS key ARN and rotation cadence.

Monica — can you create the evidence packet template in Drive and add the DocuSign agreement link? I'll try to validate an initial artifact once Sarah sends it.

- Ben
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@cloudforge.io>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Wed, 13 Oct 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Technical governance and listing checklist for partner connectors

Sarah — attaching the evidence template and a sample network topology we prefer for listing pages. I also added a DocuSign for the co-sell MOU (link below). Once we have the SOC2 PDF + KMS details, we can mark your listing as "evidence accepted" and schedule a 1hr validation run with Ben.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/redwood/partner-evidence/CF-2027-11-02
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/CF-connector-agreement-2027

Attachment: network-topology-az1.png (PNG)
Attachment: connector-cert-evidence.zip (zip, 3 files)

Best,
Monica Patel
Marketplace Ops, Redwood Inference
From: Oliver Stern <oliver.stern@platformops.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah@cloudforge.io>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 10:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Technical governance and listing checklist for partner connectors

Attached: we've uploaded the OCI image to the registry (registry.cloudforge.io/redwood/cf-connector:20271014) and the topology file to the Drive link. SOC2 PDF is pending but we can map the evidence fields if you paste the exact fields you need.

Quick checklist of what we pushed:
- registry.cloudforge.io/redwood/cf-connector:20271014 (image access via temporary token)
- topology: cloudforge-topology-single-tenant-v1.svg (in Drive)
- integration-tests: cf-connector-tests.tar.gz (sha256 provided)

We'll sign the DocuSign after you confirm the billing SKU mapping (want to ensure correct subscription tier).

—Oliver
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.inference.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah@cloudforge.io>, Oliver Stern <oliver.stern@platformops.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.inference.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Technical governance and listing checklist for partner connectors

Thanks Oliver — this is exactly what we needed. Next operational steps from Redwood:

1) Ben will run a 60-minute validation window Tues Oct 19 (we'll confirm timezone) against the image.
2) Monica will create the SKU mapping doc and propose three tiers for the marketplace listing (starter / pro / enterprise) by Oct 18.
3) I will send the explicit SOC2 evidence fields in a separate email shortly to help your security team collate.

Please sign the DocuSign after SKU mapping is confirmed so legal can finalize the co-sell addendum. If there are any egress CIDR blockers for our validation lab, flag them now.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — I'm adding the Drive link and attachments to the partner record.

Rachel
Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-marketplace-technical-checklist.pdf, network-topology-az1.png, connector-cert-evidence.zip
